{{AnimePokémonInfobox| type1=Bug| type2=Flying| trainername=Bugsy| pokemonname=Scyther| jtrainername=ツクシ| jpokemonname=ストライク| tmtrainername=Tsukushi| tmpokemonname=Strike| image=[[File:Bugsy Scyther.png|220px]]| caption=Bugsy's Scyther| gender=Unknown| ability={{a|Technician}}{{tt|*|confirmed in the games only}}| epnum=EP144| epname=Gettin' the Bugs Out| prevonum=123| current=[[Party|With Bugsy]]| java1=[[Katsuyuki Konishi]]| enva1=[[Eric Stuart]]| }} '''Bugsy's Scyther''' (Japanese: '''ツクシのストライク''' ''Tsukushi's Strike'') is [[Bugsy]]'s main {{pkmn|battle|battling}} {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in the {{pkmn|games}}, {{pkmn|animation}}, and {{pkmn|manga}}. ==In animation== ===''Pokémon the Series''=== ===={{aniseries|GS}}==== [[File:Ash Cyndaquil Bugsy Scyther.png|thumb|220px|left|Ash's Cyndaquil coming down for an aerial attack on Scyther]] {{p|Scyther}}'s appeared in ''[[EP144|Gettin' the Bugs Out]]'', where it was used in [[Bugsy]]'s [[Gym]] {{pkmn|battle}} against {{Ash}}. It first battled [[Ash's Pikachu]], which it easily defeated with a powerful combination of {{m|Slash}} and {{m|Fury Cutter}} attacks after dodging Pikachu's {{m|Thunderbolt}} with {{m|Double Team}}. It next faced off against [[Ash's Cyndaquil]] and used Double Team and Fury Cutter, which Cyndaquil dodged. Scyther used Double Team again while it used another Fury Cutter, this time faster than the other Fury Cutter, which Cyndaquil was still able to dodge. This got Cyndaquil fired up and Cyndaquil used {{m|Flamethrower}}, which removed Scyther's Double Team. The real Scyther deflected it by using Swords Dance and hit Cyndaquil. Bugsy mentioned that Scyther has a special way of deflecting {{type|Fire}} attacks by using {{m|Swords Dance}}. Bugsy told Scyther to use Fury Cutter and had it use Swords Dance when Cyndaquil was going to use Flamethrower. Ash came up with an idea and had Cyndaquil jump above Scyther and use Flamethrower while spinning, making Scyther unable to dodge and take damage. Cyndaquil was then able to finish Scyther off with a {{m|Tackle}}, winning Ash the match and earning himself the {{Badge|Hive}}. It reappeared in flashbacks in ''[[EP184|All That Glitters!]]'' and ''[[EP255|Why? Wynaut!]]''. ===Personality and characteristics=== Little is known about Scyther due to how little it has been seen. It is known to be a powerful battler, being the powerhouse of Bugsy's team. It is quick, agile, and durable. It can use its Swords Dance attack to block powerful fire moves such as {{m|Flamethrower}}. ===Moves used=== {{anmov/h|bug|flying|Bugsy Scyther {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 4}}|0=Double Team|1=Slash|2=Fury Cutter|3=Swords Dance}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 4}}|0=Double Team|1=Slash|2=Fury Cutter|3=Swords Dance}}}} {{anmov|normal|Double Team|EP144|Gettin' the Bugs Out}} {{anmov|normal|Slash|EP144|Gettin' the Bugs Out}} {{anmov|bug|Fury Cutter|EP144|Gettin' the Bugs Out}} {{anmov|normal|Swords Dance|EP144|Gettin' the Bugs Out}} {{anmov/f|flying}} ==In the games== In the [[Generation II]] games, Bugsy uses a Scyther as his highest-leveled Pokémon. In {{2v2|HeartGold|SoulSilver}}, Bugsy uses a Scyther in his first battle against the {{player}}. In his later battles, it has [[Evolution|evolved]] into {{p|Scizor}}. Bugsy also uses a Scyther in Pokémon Stadium 2. Scyther is absent in the [[Pokémon World Tournament]] of {{B2W2}}, as Bugsy uses Scizor instead. ===In the [[core series]]=== {{Pokémon/Grid}} {{Pokémon |caption='''{{game2|Gold|Silver|Crystal}}''' |gen=2 |ndex=0123 |pokemon=Scyther |gender=male |level=16 |type1=Bug |type2=Flying |move1=Fury Cutter|move1type=Bug |move2=Quick Attack|move2type=Normal |move3=Leer|move3type=Normal}} {{Pokémon |caption='''{{game|HeartGold and SoulSilver|s}}''' |gen=4 |game=HeartGold |pokemon=Scyther |gender=female |ndex=0123 |level=17 |type1=Bug|type2=Flying |held=Sitrus Berry |ability=Technician |move1=U-turn|move1type=Bug|move1cat=Physical |move2=Quick Attack|move2type=Normal|move2cat=Physical |move3=Leer|move3type=Normal|move3cat=Status |move4=Focus Energy|move4type=Normal|move4cat=Status}} {{Pokémon/Grid/end}} ===Pokémon Stadium series=== {{Pokémon/Grid}} {{Pokémon |caption='''{{g|Stadium 2}}
[[Gym Leader Castle]] Round 1''' |gen=2 |ndex=0123 |pokemon=Scyther |gender=male |level=50-100 |type1=Bug|type2=Flying |held=PRZCureBerry |move1=Fury Cutter|move1type=Bug |move2=Slash|move2type=Normal |move3=Wing Attack|move3type=Flying |move4=Hyper Beam|move4type=Normal}} {{Pokémon |caption='''{{g|Stadium 2}}
[[Gym Leader Castle]] Round 2''' |gen=2 |ndex=0123 |pokemon=Scyther |level=50-100 |gender=male |type1=Bug|type2=Flying |held=King's Rock |move1=Reversal|move1type=Fighting |move2=Hyper Beam|move2type=Normal |move3=Wing Attack|move3type=Flying |move4=Steel Wing|move4type=Steel}} {{Pokémon/Grid/end}} ===In the spin-off games=== ====[[Pokémon Masters EX]]==== {{main|Bugsy (Masters)#Scyther|Bugsy (Masters) → Scyther}} Bugsy forms a [[sync pair]] with Scyther in [[Pokémon Masters EX]]. {{PairDex/h|Flying|Bug}} {{PairDex|011|Bugsy|trainerlink=Bugsy (Masters)#Scyther|trainerimg=Bugsy|0123|Scyther|gender=male|Bug|Rock|Support|4EX|Sync Pair-Up Event}} |} ==In the manga== ===Pokémon Adventures=== [[File:Bugsy Scyther Adventures.png|200px|thumb|Scyther in [[Pokémon Adventures]]]] Scyther's only appearance was in ''[[PS158|Silly Scyther]]''. Scyther was first used to battle [[Sabrina]] at the Pokémon League preliminary tournament. It managed to deal heavy damage to Sabrina's {{p|Mr. Mime}} with consecutive uses of Fury Cutter. Eventually Mr. Mime dodged a hit, which prompted Bugsy to switch to {{p|Heracross}}. ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|bug|flying|Bugsy Scyther Fury Cutter Adventures.png|Using Fury Cutter}} {{anmov|bug|Fury Cutter|PS158|Silly Scyther}} {{anmov/f|flying}} ===Pokémon Gold & Silver: The Golden Boys=== [[File:Bugsy Scyther Golden Boys.png|200px|thumb|Scyther in Pokémon Golden Boys]] When {{GnB|Gold}} and Bugsy were having their Gym battle, Bugsy sent out {{p|Scyther}} while Gold sent out {{TP|Gold|Bayleef}}. Despite Scyther having the type-advantage and Bayleef trying to get over being abandoned from its previous [[Black (Golden Boys)|Trainer]], Scyther ended up being defeated. ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|bug|flying|Bugsy Scyther Slash Golden Boys.png|Using Slash}} {{anmov|normal|Slash|GB06|Get up Again, Bayleef}} {{anmov/f|flying}} ===Pokémon Pocket Monsters=== [[File:Bugsy Scyther PM.png|thumb|100px|Scyther in Pokémon Pocket Monsters]] Bugsy's Scyther debuted in ''[[PM079|The Hardest Insect Pokémon Wins?!]]''. After the defeat of {{p|Metapod}} and {{p|Kakuna}}, Bugsy sent out {{p|Scyther}} in his battle against {{PPM|Red}}. {{TP|Red|Clefairy}}'s rocky body caused Scyther's blade to crack. However, Clefairy had trouble controlling his rocky body, giving Scyther the advantage. However, the movement of the ground gave Clefairy some rolling power and defeated Scyther. Later, in [[PMHGSS05]], Bugsy sent out Scyther when Red had a [[rematch]] with him. Using {{TP|Red|Tyrogue}}, he was able to defeat Scyther. ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|bug|flying}} {{anmov|Normal|False Swipe|PMHGSS05| Let's Get all the Badges!{{tt|*|commanded only}}}} {{anmov/f|flying}} ==Related articles== {{Animespecies|Scyther}} {{Project Anime notice|no}} [[Category:Gym Leaders' Pokémon|Scyther]] [[Category:Gold, Silver and Crystal characters]] [[Category:HeartGold and SoulSilver characters]] [[Category:Stadium 2 characters]] [[Category:Pokémon Adventures characters (Pokémon)]] [[Category:Pokémon Gold & Silver: The Golden Boys characters]] [[es:Scyther de Bugsy/Antón]] [[it:Scyther di Raffaello]] [[zh:阿筆的飛天螳螂]]
